content.comment_body: Hi! I'm encountering trouble transferring a program between my PC and [product_name]. When I enter the IP for [product_name] and check the connection, it shows as connected. However, after attempting to transfer the program, the usual confirmation window does not appear, and the program isn't transferred to [product_name]. With an older unit, the transfer completes normally. Yet, with three recently acquired [product_name] devices, I consistently see this issue on all of them. Thanks, [user_name]

Which version of [product_name] do you have? Is it one of the older hardware revisions, or the latest release? If you're using the newest revision, make sure to use [product_name] software [version_no]. Here’s a helpful link: [url] It explains why program downloads may not work on the new [product_name] units.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report inconsistent program transfers to new [product_name] devices over Ethernet when using the same software and method. The issue appears to stem from compatibility between specific hardware versions and versions of the programming software, with confirmation prompts failing to appear in recent units.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect program transfers to work consistently across all [product_name] hardware versions, with confirmation dialogs and dependable operation for every device.
